notes.title: QoL improvements
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone who has played the game so far :-)
Here are some quality of life improvements to make the experience smoother!!

Added a quick restart button after excavations
You can now hold down the [spoiler]Wish[/spoiler] button to spam buy it
Adjusted the colors of the transition effects to be darker
Some other very minor adjustments


<3

notes.title: Achievement Bug Fix
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where a certain 2 achievements weren't unlocking properly!
